sources.excerpt: Pig Fuzz – coopersonic coopersonic hand-built, high-quality effects pedals Pig Fuzz now available, it’s sick… Plenty of Germaniacs in stock. Dual Valve Distortions will be back in a few weeks; contact us if you want to be notified… And some BAD news – as if Brexit wasn’t shitty enough, we are unable to ship to the EU until we’ve got sorted with the new GPSR regulations. For a small operation like us it’s a big pain in the arse. In the meantime you can always get your mates in the UK/outside the EU to get stuff for you… Pedals Germaniac Dual-Valve Distortion (Regular) Dual-Valve Distortion (Deluxe) The Pig Fuzz Testimonials Support FAQ Pedals Pedal Repair Info User manuals Partners Hot Rox UK Nottingham City Guitars Xperience Guitars Gear Repairs Contact Cart Shop Your cart is currently empty! Home  /  distortion  / Pig Fuzz Pig Fuzz £ 80.00 – £ 90.00 version Choose an option Footswitch Desktop Clear Pig Fuzz quantity Add to cart Category: distortion Description Additional information Description The Coopersonic Pig Fuzz – bringing meaty fuzz to you in a can. The wartime favourite contents have been removed and fed to my cats. The can has then been filled with a silicon fuzz circuit based on the renowned Jordan Boss Tone, but with a high impedance FET buffer, bigger capacitors for a fatter sound and of course like most things Coopersonic, stupid amounts of gain. This will get quite unstable at high gain giving low octaves and brutal fuzz. 9V DC “Boss” type adapter operation only – no batteries in this puppy. Available in two versions – footswitch version, and desktop version for the tabletop tweaking community.
